entities.summary: Konrad Abeltshauser is a German professional ice hockey defenceman for EHC Red Bull München of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Abeltshauser was selected by the San Jose Sharks in the 6th round of the 2010 NHL Entry Draft.
